name: BrowserStack
description_en:
BrowserStack provides cloud browser/device testing through distinct manual and automated products. Its Local Testing feature lets those remote sessions reach an authorized private or staging application through an outbound connection from a local agent. A remote test session and the Local connection have separate lifecycles.

For automated Selenium-oriented evaluation, the SDK can move platform and Local settings into browserstack.yml. Those settings can override the test suite’s capabilities. Check the effective configuration, tunnel scope and product-specific quota rather than assuming a local test script executes with unchanged settings or one family-wide allowance.
description_zh:
BrowserStack 通过不同的手动与自动化产品提供云端浏览器／设备测试。Local Testing 从本地代理建立出站连接，使远端会话访问获准私网或 staging 应用；远端测试会话与 Local 连接有独立生命周期。

自动化 Selenium 方向的评估可用 SDK 将平台及 Local 设置放入 browserstack.yml，但该文件会覆盖测试套件的能力设置。应核对最终配置、隧道范围及具体产品额度，不能假定本地脚本设置不变或整个家族共用一种额度。

core_features.explanation_en: A local agent supplies an outbound path from cloud test sessions to permitted internal targets.
core_features.explanation_zh: 本地代理为云端会话提供访问获准内部目标的出站路径。

core_features.explanation_en: Duplicate capabilities in browserstack.yml take precedence over values in test scripts.
core_features.explanation_zh: 重复能力设置以 browserstack.yml 为准，覆盖脚本值。

core_features.explanation_en: The official FAQ assigns different minute allowances to Live, AppLive, Automate and AppAutomate.
core_features.explanation_zh: 官方 FAQ 为 Live、AppLive、Automate、AppAutomate 分配不同分钟额度。

en: Verify one cloud browser against an authorized staging assertion.
Compare SDK overrides and both session/tunnel teardown paths.
zh: 用一个云浏览器验证获准 staging 断言。
比较 SDK 覆盖以及会话／隧道两种结束路径。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Select the product and account allowance, then define a small browser/platform matrix.
steps.zh: 选择产品及账户额度，再定义小型浏览器／平台矩阵。

steps.en: Review effective SDK capabilities, authorized Local targets and complete teardown before expansion.
steps.zh: 扩大前检查最终 SDK 能力、获准 Local 目标及完整结束流程。

items.en: An SDK configuration can override capabilities already present in a test script.
items.zh: SDK 配置可覆盖测试脚本已有能力设置。

items.en: The FAQ and vendor article disagree on the Automate trial allowance.
items.zh: FAQ 与官方文章对 Automate 试用额度描述不同。

pricing.summary_en: Official support documents temporary product-specific trials, not one unlimited platform plan. A vendor Automate article quotes from $99/month without a verified final cycle/offer and conflicts with the support FAQ on trial minutes. No pricing-root body, checkout, enterprise quote or family-wide entitlement was established.
pricing.summary_zh: 官方支持记录按产品划分的临时试用，并非平台无限量方案。官方 Automate 文章列月价 $99 起，但最终周期／方案未确认，试用分钟数也与 FAQ 冲突。未确认价格根页正文、结算、企业报价或整个家族权益。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Proposed examples were not executed.

sections.title_en: Choose a product and a representative assertion
sections.title_zh: 选择产品及代表性断言
sections.en: The documentation separates manual, automated and low-code workflows across web and mobile. Start with the required test type, a known environment and one observable assertion. Shared infrastructure or an SDK link to another BrowserStack product does not demonstrate that the other product’s subscription, screenshot capacity or device entitlement is included.
sections.zh: 文档区分 Web／移动端的手动、自动化及低代码流程。应从测试类型、已知环境及一个可观察断言开始。共用基础设施或 SDK 链接到另一产品，不证明其订阅、截图额度或设备权益包含。

sections.title_en: Separate tunnel setup from browser routing
sections.title_zh: 区分隧道建立与浏览器路由
sections.en: The Local agent authenticates with an access key, receives a repeater assignment and opens an outbound encrypted connection. The guide says only allowed local servers are reachable through that agent. A firewall blocking WebSockets can cause a slower legacy-protocol fallback. Verify the intended host and denied destinations with synthetic content before exposing a broader internal range.
sections.zh: Local 代理以 access key 认证、取得 repeater 分配并建立出站加密连接。指南说明仅可通过代理访问允许的本地服务器；防火墙阻断 WebSocket 可能回退较慢旧协议。扩大内部地址范围前，应以模拟内容验证目标主机及被拒目标。

sections.title_zh: 检查合并后的 SDK 配置
sections.en: The SDK intercepts test execution and merges capabilities. A duplicate value in browserstack.yml wins over the script; root settings and per-platform objects have different scope. For example, inspect the effective browser/platform and certificate-validation options instead of only reviewing the original script. The documented configuration example is not a current device-availability or framework-compatibility test.
sections.zh: SDK 拦截执行并合并能力，重复值以 browserstack.yml 为准；根设置与逐平台对象范围不同。例如应检查最终浏览器／平台及证书验证选项，不能只看原脚本。文档配置例不构成当前设备可用性或框架兼容测试。

sections.title_en: End the Local connection as well as the session
sections.title_zh: 同时结束 Local 连接与会话
sections.en: The architecture guide describes ending a remote browsing session separately from stopping the Local connection. Stopping the local agent severs its secure repeater connection; the cloud side also removes connection information. Include both teardown paths in a pilot and inspect remaining processes/connections. That documented connection cleanup is not proof of every test artifact’s retention or deletion policy.
sections.zh: 架构指南分别说明结束远端浏览会话与停止 Local 连接。停止本地代理会切断 repeater 安全连接，云端也移除连接信息。试点需覆盖两种结束路径并检查残余进程／连接；连接清理说明不证明所有测试产物的保留或删除政策。

sections.title_en: Do not merge inconsistent trial allowances
sections.title_zh: 不要合并不一致的试用额度
sections.en: The support FAQ lists Live/AppLive30 minutes each, Automate60 minutes and AppAutomate100 minutes. A vendor Automate article instead advertises a100-minute automation trial and pricing from $99/month. The mismatch remains unresolved; the article is not a full quote or billing-cycle specification. Confirm the selected product’s actual offer and account allowance before budgeting a test matrix.
sections.zh: 支持 FAQ 列 Live／AppLive 各三十分钟、Automate 六十分钟、AppAutomate 一百分钟；另一官方 Automate 文章却称自动化试用一百分钟、月价 $99 起。差异未解决，文章不是完整报价或周期说明。预算测试矩阵前应确认具体产品实际方案及账户额度。
